title: Air Dry Clay Earrings Tutorial | No Oven Needed! 🎨
description:
Learn how to make beautiful air dry clay earrings - no oven needed! Perfect for beginners. 
In this tutorial, I'll show you how to create stunning earrings using Japanese air dry clay from Aura Clay®. No baking required!

✨ What you'll need:
- Air dry clay
- Earring hooks
- Basic tools

🎨 Perfect for beginners - no special equipment needed!
